name: MAX3490ESA+T
title: MAX3483/MAX3485/MAX3486/MAX3488/MAX3490/MAX3491: 3.3 V RS-485/RS-422 transceivers, 250 kbps to 10 Mbps
summary: A family of 3.3 V transceivers for RS-485 and RS-422, one driver and one receiver each. Three are half duplex in the 75176 pinout (MAX3483 250 kbps slew limited, MAX3486 2.5 Mbps, MAX3485 10 Mbps); three are full duplex (MAX3488 250 kbps, MAX3490 10 Mbps, both 8 pin without enables; MAX3491 10 Mbps, 14 pin with enables). Drivers are current limited and thermally protected, the receiver reads high with open inputs, and the parts with enables have a 2 nA shutdown. The MAX3485ESA is the 10 Mbps half-duplex part in 8-pin SO, -40 °C to +85 °C.

pins.name: RO
pins.function: Receiver output. High when A is at least 200 mV above B, low when A is at least 200 mV below B; high with both bus inputs open.

pins.name: RE
pins.function: Receiver output enable, active low. Low turns RO on; high leaves RO at high impedance. RE high with DE low puts the device into low-power shutdown.

pins.name: DE
pins.function: Driver output enable, active high. High turns the driver outputs on and the part drives the line; low leaves them at high impedance. RE high with DE low puts the device into low-power shutdown. With the driver at high impedance and RE low, the part listens to the line as a receiver.

operation.text: Six 3.3 V RS-485/RS-422 transceivers, each with one driver and one receiver. The MAX3483, MAX3485 and MAX3486 are half duplex, sharing A and B between driver and receiver, in the 75176 pin arrangement. The MAX3488, MAX3490 and MAX3491 are full duplex, with the driver on Y/Z and the receiver on A/B. Driver and receiver enables are on the MAX3483, MAX3485, MAX3486 and MAX3491; the MAX3488 and MAX3490 have none. Speed grades: MAX3483 and MAX3488 250 kbps, slew limited; MAX3486 2.5 Mbps, partly slew limited; MAX3485, MAX3490 and MAX3491 10 Mbps. C grade is 0 °C to +70 °C, E grade -40 °C to +85 °C.
Runs from one 3.3 V supply (3.0 V to 3.6 V) with no charge pump. The logic inputs have a 2.0 V high threshold and are rated to 7 V; the parts interoperate with 5 V logic.
Receiver input resistance is at least 12 kΩ over -7 V to +12 V common mode, so up to 32 transceivers can share a bus.
With both receiver inputs open, RO is high.

The MAX3483 and MAX3488 drivers have limited edge rates, which cut EMI and the reflections from a badly terminated cable. Driving a 125 kHz signal, the MAX3485/MAX3490/MAX3491 output spectrum carries strong high harmonics; the MAX3483/MAX3488 spectrum for the same signal has much smaller ones (10 dB/div, 0 Hz to 5 MHz at 500 kHz/div).

Driving RE high and DE low together shuts the MAX3483, MAX3485, MAX3486 and MAX3491 down; with only one of the driver or receiver disabled the part stays awake. Shutdown supply current is 2 nA typical, 1 µA max. The inputs must stay in that state for 300 ns to be sure of shutdown; under 80 ns they never cause it. tPSH, tPSL, tPRSH and tPRSL are enable times from shutdown; tPZH, tPZL, tPRZH and tPRZL are from a disabled but awake part.
A disabled driver or receiver output sits at high impedance. On the half-duplex parts, with DE low and RE low the part listens as a receiver; with DE high it drives the line.

Two mechanisms limit output current and dissipation under faults or bus contention: a foldback current limit in the output stage that acts at once against shorts anywhere in the common-mode range, and a thermal shutdown that puts the driver outputs at high impedance if the die gets too hot. Short-circuit output current is 250 mA max at -7 V or 12 V.

Skew, the difference between low-to-high and high-to-low delay, sets how well the 50% duty cycle is kept. Receiver skew is under 10 ns (20 ns on the MAX3483/MAX3488). Driver skew is 8 ns on the MAX3485/MAX3490/MAX3491, 11 ns on the MAX3486 and typically under 100 ns on the MAX3483/MAX3488.
The RS-485/RS-422 standard covers lines up to 4000 ft; a repeater extends past that. Both slow and fast parts carry a 125 kHz signal over 4000 ft of 26 AWG twisted pair into 120 Ω loads.

A line terminated at each end with its own characteristic impedance, and with short stubs off it, keeps reflections down. The slew-limited MAX3483/MAX3488 and partly slew-limited MAX3486 cope better with imperfect termination.
On the half-duplex parts, the Y and Z of the timing, test and waveform figures are pins A and B with DE high.
Die size 0.146 in (3.71 mm) by 0.086 in (2.18 mm), 810 transistors, substrate tied to ground.
